message: What items do I need to hold for my objective? I can gather supplies for your wheat, cocoa, and mud items too.
!startConversation("Jill_0", "You need to hold paper, a golden apple, sugar, and bone_meal. Could you tell me my objective items and gather wheat, cocoa, and mud supplies?")
